items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section IV, List of Answers on Topics 1:1
items.html: The first is the expansion of the spirituality — that is, the five phases of lights called Nefesh, Ruach, Neshama, Haya, Yechida. The second is the five phases of vessels, called KHB, ZA and Malchut. And one must distinguish between them in every word of this wisdom, for there is no light without a vessel, and they are opposite to one another in all their appearances. For the order of the revelation of the vessels is from above downward: KHB, ZA and Malchut; and the order of the revelation of the lights is the opposite, from below upward: Nefesh, Ruach, Neshama, Haya, Yechida. And the lack of the lower vessels in the Partzuf causes the lack of the upper lights there, so that with even a slight forgetting of the need to recognise the oppositeness between them, the matter will at once become confused. (Chapter 1, Item 2)
